route_title: Dual-band rejection filter with visible passband using Ta2O5/SiO2 periodic stack
compilation_rationale: Bounded route compiles a fixed 36-layer alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 stack with explicit bounds and target bands. Optimization targets average and worst-case transmittance in specified windows using coherent TMM. Downstream metrics are reserved for post-run reporting.
